extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting short fiction to the Writer's Digest Short Short Story Competition (contest entrants)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and submission guidelines for entering the Writer's Digest Short Short Story Competition (short fiction, 1,500 words or fewer). Covers eligibility, formatting, file types, fees, deadlines, and prize/rights conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word count limit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Word count refers to all words making up the story (no matter the number of letters in the word). Do not count the title or contact information in the word count. Entry forms must list the word count where requested. Entries exceeding the 1,500 word limit will be disqualified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All entries must be in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / prior publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Only original works that have not been published (at the time of submission) in print, digital or online publications will be considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Self-published work in blogs, on social media, etc. will be considered. Previous top winning entries from this and other WD competitions are ineligible except in the case of substantial rewrites.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI-generated / AI-assisted works
rubrics_metrics.description: Any AI-generated or AI-assisted work will NOT be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method (Submittable) and online-only
rubrics_metrics.description: All entries must be submitted online through Submittable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create or log in to a Submittable account and submit via the SUBMIT button. Online entry forms must have the word count listed where requested. All entries must be submitted online and accompanied by the required entry fee at time of entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted file formats
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attach zipped files, or documents stored on the web like Google doc’s etc. Files are not returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: The submission file (both the manuscript/story itself as well as the file name) should not include any identifying information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When filling out the online submission form, include contact information only on the submission form (not on the submission’s file upload). The submitter is who will be referred to as the author; if the submitter and author differ, indicate accordingly in parenthesis on the submitter name line. If you write under a pen name, please indicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting preferences and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Please submit text only; illustrations are not accepted. Preferred formatting: Letter, 8.5 x 11, single sided, normal 1-inch margins; double-spaced; 12-point type size preferred but not mandatory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a font which is easy to read; do not use a decorative or script font. There are no requirements as to the number of words per page.

rubrics_metrics.name: File naming guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Please name your file the same as your submission title if possible; identifying information should not be included in your file name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid adding symbols/punctuation in file names of the document file which you are uploading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry fees, payment methods, and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries must be accompanied by the required entry fee and payments must be submitted at the time of entry. All deadlines are at 11:59 PM EST on the specified date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry fees may be paid online by credit/debit card (MC, V, AMEX & DISC) or PayPal. Early-bird and regular fees/dates are published (e.g., Early-Bird: Nov 17, 2025 — $30; Deadline: Dec 15, 2025 — $35; Extended: Jan 15, 2026 — $35).

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple submissions and resubmissions
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no cap as to the number of submissions that can be entered into the competition overall; however each submission must be checked out separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once an entry has been submitted, no edits, replacements or exchanges will be accepted. If you wish to submit an edited or revised version of a previously submitted entry, you may enter it as a new submission (you may wish to edit the title slightly as well to differentiate them).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility restrictions (who may not enter)
rubrics_metrics.description: The following are not permitted to enter the contest, neither under their legal names nor pen names: employees of Active Interest Media and their immediate family members; Writer’s Digest Books authors; Writer's Digest contributing editors and columnists; and Writer’s Digest instructors for online courses and live webinars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grand Prize-winning authors from this and other WD competitions, within the three years of being awarded, are not eligible. Ineligible entries will be disqualified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: WD writing competitions are open to U.S. and non-U.S. residents; however, due to U.S. Government restrictions we are unable to accept entries from Syria, Iran, North Korea, or Crimea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disqualification and rejection policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries exceeding the word limit will be disqualified. Writer's Digest reserves the right to reject work deemed unsuitable for publication or that does not meet all named criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writer’s Digest assumes all entries are original and are the works and property of the entrant. Writer’s Digest is not liable for any copyright infringement on the part of the entrant and will not become involved in copyright disputes. Refunds are not provided for disqualified, withdrawn or non-winning entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging process and finality
rubrics_metrics.description: Every qualified entry will be read by the judges. Judges’ decisions are final.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners will be notified by specified dates (top Award Winners will be notified on or before Feb 28, 2026). Entrants not selected as winners will not be notified individually; non-winners will be emailed a competition status update in the weeks following the winner notification date. Judges' decisions are final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winner publication and recognition rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication of winning pieces and announcement in Writer’s Digest magazine and on WritersDigest.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writer’s Digest retains one-time nonexclusive publication rights to the First Place and top winning entries to be published in a Writer’s Digest publication. Winners receive name/story listing in the magazine and on the website, a special graphic recognizing winning status, and other publicity such as an interview with a WD editor for the First Place Winner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prize conditions and obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: First Place Winner will receive cash, publication, a paid trip to the Writer’s Digest Conference, and other prizes; other place winners receive cash/gift certificates and publication/recognition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the First Place Winner accepts the Conference portion of their prize they must agree to travel (flying round-trip from the same city) during the conference dates in 2026. The editors or agents who meet with the First Place Winner are under no obligation to read, buy or represent the First Place Winner's work. Winners must fill out and submit appropriate tax related forms in order to receive cash awards; if not submitted within 60 days of request, cash awards may be forfeited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information accuracy and communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide accurate contact information on the submission form; competition-related updates and winner notifications are sent via email and/or Submittable messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure the email address you provide will be valid throughout the competition span. Check your SPAM folder and the MESSAGES tab within Submittable. Be sure that Writer’s Digest and Submittable emails are not blocked. Incorrect email addresses may result in delayed or unsuccessful transmission of important information. Non-winners receive a status update rather than individual notification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content and subject-matter freedom
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no rules or requirements regarding subject matter or language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit text only; illustrations are not accepted.
